programs.title: Secret Headquarters
programs.desc: Family comedy with Michael Peña. A young lad discovers that his slacker dad is a superhero. And before he's got used to the idea, he must foil a villain's plot to bring his dad down.

programs.title: The Black Swan
programs.desc: Swashbuckling adventure with Laird Cregar and Tyrone Power. Privateer Captain Henry Morgan tries to rid the Caribbean of pirates when he's made Governor of Jamaica. Bit rich.

programs.title: Romancing the Stone
programs.desc: Comedy action adventure starring Michael Douglas and Kathleen Turner. An adventurer helps a bestselling author to search for her sister, who's been kidnapped in Colombia.

programs.title: Fisherman's Friends
programs.desc: Heart-warming comedy based on the real-life story of the Cornish folk ensemble who took the UK charts by storm in 2010, starring Daniel Mays and Tuppence Middleton.

programs.title: The Woman King
programs.desc: Historical action starring Viola Davis. An elite force of female warriors, the Agojie, protect their West African kingdom from threats from rival kingdoms and from European slavers.

programs.title: Sleep
programs.desc: Nightmarish horror about a man who may actually sleepwalk into harming his wife and unborn child. Or is something spookier going on? With Jung Yu-mi and Lee Sun-kyun. In Korean/subs.
